correctness.rationale: Correct all-length claim: cyclic reversal is equivalent to a two-palindrome decomposition; δ^j has a common palindromic prefix and preserves reversal-conjugacy; aligned factor rotation gives positive families. An odd rotation cannot match δ(v) with δ(v^R) if v contains 1, preserving the bad length-seven obstruction. The independently established factor-complexity recurrence and the cited exact published palindromic-periodicity count restrict all other lengths. Direct enumeration verifies all conclusions through length 192 without being used to infer infinity.

value.rationale: Provides an exact infinite arithmetic classification of a natural property-PP length spectrum for a canonical aperiodic automatic word, not a small special computation. Resolves the gap between all factors being palindromic periodicities and actual palindrome pairs, with an explicit infinite sequence of separating witnesses. Useful for structurally distinguishing two standard palindromic factor invariants.
